zh.title: 國防部：7艘共艦15架次共機侵擾台周邊空域
zh.summary: 國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處
body: 國防部發布共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲7艘共艦、6艘公務船及20架次共機，其中15架次共機侵擾北部、中部、西南及東部空域，持續在台海周邊活動。
國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
據本站統計紀錄，前一次紀錄（8月18日）為共機13架次、共艦8艘、公務船7艘；近30日（共15筆紀錄）平均為共機6.3架次/日、共艦8.1艘/日，近30日單日最高為共機13架次（8月18日）。

en.title: Taiwan MND: 7 PLA vessels, 15 PLA aircraft sorties near Taiwan airspace
en.summary: Taiwan MND reports 7 PLA vessels, 6 official ships and 15 PLA aircraft sorties near Taiwan; armed forces monitoring
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense (MND) released its latest PLA activity update, reporting that from 6 a.m. yesterday to 6 a.m. today it detected 7 PLA vessels, 6 official ships and 20 PLA aircraft sorties, of which 15 sorties entered northern, central, southwestern and eastern airspace around Taiwan, continuing to operate in the vicinity of the Taiwan Strait.
The MND emphasized that the armed forces utilized mission aircraft and vessels as well as shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the situation.

According to this site's statistical records, the previous entry (August 18) logged 13 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 PLA vessels and 7 official ships; the 30-day average across 15 entries was 6.3 aircraft sorties/day and 8.1 vessels/day, with the 30-day single-day high of 13 aircraft sorties recorded on August 18.
